text: Janto kadi an Muhammadu, tuma nde Joomi maa yaltinnoo e keeci ɓiɗɓe Aadama ɓen jurriiyaaji maɓɓe ɗin, O seedintini ɓe wonnde mo bajjo taguɗo ɓe jeyɗo ɓe, O Daalani ɓe : "Wanaa Min woni Joomi mon?" Ɓe jaabii : "Ko non woni, ko An woni Joomi amen". O Daali : "Ko Men ƴettidani ndii ahadi e mo'on, ko fii wata on yeddoy Ñalnde Darngal, wi'oyon : "On anndaano ɗum".
